summary: Tested Upcoming Features (roadmap) feature end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass — admin gating (403 for non-admin on POST/PUT/DELETE), CRUD, sort ascending by release_date, status validation (invalid -> 'On The List'), empty-title features dropped, missing-date rejected (400), missing-id update returns 404, and GET reflects updates/deletes. Frontend (Expo web preview, 390x844): Admin (mechanicltz) sees the new ROADMAP section as the first section on the Vault/More tab with 'Upcoming Features' AND 'Admin · Manage Roadmap' rows; Facebook 'Follow us on Facebook' row visible at the bottom. Admin/manage page loads with the NEW DATED UPDATE create button; modal opens with date, title, feature rows, and the status pill correctly cycles On The List -> Work Started -> Completed -> On The List. The user-facing /upcoming-features screen shows the 'Want your idea to be put on this list? Send us a Message' prompt and the ReportBugBadge (testID upcoming-feedback). Non-admin (ryan@ryan.com): visiting /admin/upcoming-features correctly redirects to /more; /upcoming-features is reachable and shows the prompt + badge. All test releases created during testing were cleaned up via the DELETE endpoint (verified zero TEST_ releases remain).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_upcoming.py is clean — uses real_db directly for the global collection, _clean_features properly validates statuses & drops empty titles, all admin routes go through _require_admin, and _id is excluded from queries.
Status cycle on the admin modal works smoothly via cycleStatus(). The DateField is the standard cross-platform MM/DD/YYYY masked input used elsewhere in the app, so admin entry is consistent.
seed_data_creation: Test releases were created during backend pytest run and the admin UI walkthrough; ALL were deleted via the admin DELETE endpoint and a final cleanup pass confirmed zero TEST_ releases remain in the upcoming_releases collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_upcoming_features.py and clean up after themselves (test_zz_admin_delete_releases runs last). The frontend DateField expects MM/DD/YYYY when typed (not ISO) — pass '08/15/2099' not '2099-08-15' when filling [data-testid="upcoming-date"] in Playwright. The admin gate on /admin/upcoming-features redirects to /(tabs)/more which the router normalises to '/more'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Feature works as specified.
